name: Spartan Chosen
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee infantry · shields · 305 leadership · Seasonal (Sparta)
pitch: A heavily armored shield-wall anchor that thrives in blob and skirmish but crumbles to huge burst damage from units like Iron Reapers, Claymores, or Orochi. Its Oath of Unity trait spreads and mitigates incoming harm for 5s after every spell cast, making it the frontline unit that opens the enemy's block for your team to push in.

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: Nerfs guided this unit toward the Tank Line over the DPS line — consistent mitigation across all scenarios.

battleRole.positioning: Frontline anchor — hold the line and block ranged fire. Never hesitate to redirect and reposition before pressing ability 2, and activate CCi + X-move back if overextended. {1} Pair with tanky units like Spear Sergeants in TW, playing aggressively on push or defence — its role is to go first and soak attention/damage while pushing forward. {2}
battleRole.tips: Ability 1 (No Mercy) redirects to your facing and stabs in front; each stab heals 5% HP. {1} Ability 2 (shield advance) requires re-pressing during the advance to stab; the 3rd press jumps forward with big damage. {1} Main trait (Oath of Unity): for 5s after using a spell, all damage taken spreads through the unit and is reduced to 70% (30% dmg reduction net). {1} Don't leave it idling at the gate — use downtime to farm rage, and cycle it to supply and back rather than parking it forward. {5}
